_comment: Engineering synonym table for tools/icons-v12/assign_icons.py. 'en': project term (word or phrase, plural-insensitive) -> icon targets 'name[:weight]' (full Tabler/MDI icon names or single name tokens); a term listed here uses ONLY its targets (no literal match). 'names': proper nouns -> generic terms separated by '|'. 'zh': Traditional Chinese keyword -> English terms separated by '|'. 'category': catalog category -> weak fallback terms. 'themes': per-category ordered glyph lists (theme bonus, first = strongest). 'theme_prefixes': per-category glyph-name prefixes whose families form the next theme tier. 'generic': words that only act as weak tie-breakers (weight multiplier). 'stop': ignored words. 'summary_stop': template words ignored in summaries.
